4.1 Therapeutic indications
Kapruvia is indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe pruritus associated with chronic kidney disease in adult
patients on haemodialysis (see section 5.1).
4.2 Posology and method of administration

Can you write the "Posology and method of administration" subsection — dosing for adults, titration in patients with rapidly progressing disease, and adjustments for those near end of life?

Can you write the "Posology and method of administration" subsection — daily dosing for kids by age group, how to take it with food, and notes for caregivers?
